facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: regulator directive concerning positive isolation verification at CY-3210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on CY-3210 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically managing corrosion and thinning findings. CY-3210 (cyclone clusters) is in service for classification duty on the grinding circuit. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 9 November 2022 a regulatory notice was issued concerning CY-3210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following commissioning of replacement equipment.
